title: Gekirindan
overview:
A fierce time-travel shooter!!

Brave Hokuto, beautiful Shario, fight alongside your comrades. Defeat your archenemy "Gearndigas" and save humanity from the brink of extinction!

Chase the enemy through time in this vertically scrolling arcade shooter, battling from your own era back to a world war, through the present day and on into two different futures. Pick one of three fighter types and blast through waves of enemy craft and giant bosses, alone or with a friend.

One button fires and another drops a powerful bomb that wipes out most enemies and bullets. Collect power-ups to strengthen your shot and add homing missiles, lasers or napalm, and gather medals for bonus points at the end of each stage.

- One or two players at once
- Play on a horizontal screen or in the arcade's vertical layout

激闘!タイムトラベルシューティング!!

勇敢なる北斗よ、美しいシャリオよ、仲間とともに闘え。仇敵「ギアンディガス」を倒して、人類滅亡の危機から救え!
